sample.question:
At each crossing, W means the vertical warp strand is on top and H means the horizontal weft is on top. The ideal first row is visible; each following ideal row rotates the previous pattern right by 1 position(s). Coordinates are zero-based (row,column).
After adding two more ideal rows, which strand will be on top in column 2 of the second new row?
A. MISSING
B. BOTH
C. WEFT
D. WARP
sample.analysis: The second new row has phase 1 and pattern W H H H W H. Column 2 is H, so the answer is C.
